title: Materialization for metric views is generally available
body: Materialization for [metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views) is now generally available. Materialization uses materialized views to pre-compute metric view results and rewrites matching queries to read from them, which accelerates queries. Materialization requires Databricks Runtime 17.3 or above. See [Materialization for metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/materialization).
